resolutions.bounded_interpretation: The crew explicitly began a regional color discussion, sought a farside comparison, contrasted farside color/albedo, and mapped a regional boundary. The plan title was not spoken, so this is content-led execution rather than an exact-title anchor.
Regional color and albedo discussion begins 14.392 seconds after the request and later addresses the plan-named Byrgius A and Pierazzo areas. The title itself is not spoken.
Retrospective speech proves that the search occurred and reports a negative observation, but only bounds the start as earlier than the recorder cue. It does not prove entry inside the request window.

The planned window contains Earthshine description, flash-watching, a two-observer flash report, and timeline re-synchronization, but no distinct synthesis of flyby observations or future Artemis science operations. One overlapping image activity label is not content evidence.
Earthshine-specific camera setup and Moon descriptions support the Eclipsed Moon member of the simultaneous pair. Capture is crew-reported only; no image product is admitted as visual validation.

Starfield transition, reported star photography, and a Venus observation separately support Deep Space during the same window as Eclipsed Moon. The first cue precedes the request by 26.516 seconds and remains an audit locator, not a boundary.
Earthshine and surface-feature descriptions continue during the second repeated pair. The transcript gap prevents an exact restart time.
An explicit continuation of Deep Space is followed by distinct planet/star and Mars observations. These cues are separate from the simultaneous Earthshine evidence.

The crew explicitly orients to the planned corona observation, reports streamers, and observes the Sun emerge. The physical emergence cue occurs inside the request window and 75.295 seconds before the plan's physical start field.
